body: ### Bug fixes - A manifest that is not valid UTF-8 now reports that pipx cannot read it, instead of ending in a traceback ([#2512](https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2512)) by @qianeric-backup and @gaborbernat. - Report invalid PEP 723 script command names before installation and suggest using `--app` with a valid name ([#2511](https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2511)) by @xixi-box and @gaborbernat. - Run a script from a URL or a named pipe that starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark, instead of failing with a `SyntaxError` ([#2513](https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2513)) by @DheerajPiduru52 and @gaborbernat. - Stop pipx from crashing with `InterpolationSyntaxError` when the pipx home, or the virtual environment given to `--python`, has a `%` in its path ([#2504](https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2504)) by @DheerajPiduru52 and @gaborbernat. - Treat an empty `PIPX_DEFAULT_PYTHON` as unset again, as pipx does for its path variables, instead of failing every command with an interpreter error ([#2505](https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2505)) by @DheerajPiduru52. - `pipx run` now infers entry points for local project paths whose names contain no normalization characters (such as `dist/my-app`) on both the `pip` and `uv` backends ([#2502](https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2502)) by @Cyber-Marty and @gaborbernat. ### Documentation - Move the package author guide to the how-to section as `Make packages compatible` and document shipping man pages and shell completion scripts with setuptools, pdm-backend, uv_build and hatchling ([#2514](https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2514)) by @Vrihub and @gaborbernat. ### New Contributors - @DheerajPiduru52 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2513 - @Vrihub made their first contribution in https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2514 - @qianeric-backup made their first contribution in https://github.com/pypa/pipx/pull/2512 [🐍 PyPI release](https://pypi.org/project/pipx/1.19.2/) [📜 Full Changelog](https://github.com/pypa/pipx/compare/1.19.1...1.19.2)
